mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_code (phone, code, expire_at) VALUES (#{phone}, #{code}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, phone, code, attempt_count, expire_at, created_at FROM sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_code SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
